text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Yeah. I'm okay. I'm calm.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Starting today, I'm staying true to my 
level. I'll bloom properly right where I 
am—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. Let's go train."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? From Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: A change in training policy?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I took another look over the whole 
thing.

Yeah, I went over the whole thing and 
revised it

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's have a look.
choice_data_list: ああ、内容を全体的に見直してみたんだ
うん、内容を全体的に見直してみたんだ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...! W-What is this...? Hasn't everything 
gotten way too laid-back here...?!)
choice_data_list:
What do you think from your perspective, 
Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm...
choice_data_list: ラックから見て、どうかな

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you've left me with quite a bit of 
leeway, haven't you? Personally, I 
wouldn't mind if you packed a bit more 
in."
choice_data_list:
Still, with how you are now, you'll be 
fine with this.

Still, with how you are now, you'll be 
fine with this.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: でも、今の君ならこれで大丈夫だよ
でも、今の貴方ならこれで大丈夫だよ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...? What do you mean by 
that...?
choice_data_list: 君はもう、十分強いからね
貴方はもう、十分強いからね

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: 俺も、身の丈に合わせることにしたんだ
私も、身の丈に合わせることにしたんだ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is—
choice_data_list: ……『もうええわ』、だろ？
……『もうええわ』、でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
“—Why are ya so shocked? It's only 
natural, ain't it?”

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who said it, weren't you? 
"I'm done."

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
You just understood how I felt, fair and 
square, Trainer. You didn't do anything 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. I definitely said it... 
but...—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list:
It's been tough lately, so let's take more 
breaks.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—
choice_data_list: これまでハードだったし、休みも増やそう

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. Trainer-san, you're really so kind. 
You look out for me so much.
choice_data_list: 無理もしてきたからね。でももう大丈夫

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine. You've worked hard 
enough already. No one's gonna complain.

text_block_list.name: Shadow of Flowers
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, they might even console you, 
ya know? Saying, 'You did great going up 
against Almond Eye.'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Even so, this is just... so sudden...!
choice_data_list: —Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer...—
choice_data_list: ――――ラック

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Stop...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Don't look at me... with those pitying 
eyes... please—)
choice_data_list: You've really worked hard up until now.

You've really done your best all this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: 本当に、今まで頑張ったな
本当に、今まで頑張ったね

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ――――もう、無理して女王でいなくていい

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ...Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No way... I totally hate this...!
choice_data_list: ……ラック？

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah did say that, it's true...! Ah was the 
one who went, "Forget it already!"...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Even so...!! Even still...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't want Trainer... to ever think 
'I've had enough of her' about me...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be told “You don't have to 
be queen”...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Making her say something like that...! 
I'm so uncool and pathetic, I can't 
forgive myself...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What's with that "live within your means" 
garbage? What's with "I can shine bright 
enough here"...?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What's with that "I'll yield the 
spotlight" crap?! You absolute 
dumbass!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Don't act all cool!! Stop playing smart!!! 
Ya just ran away, didn'tcha?!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I was so scared of losing to Ai-san next 
time……!! I hated the thought of losing my 
pride as Queen……! I just didn't want to be 
humiliated—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ye just... gave up on playin' the straight 
man, didn't ye...?!!
choice_data_list: ...Then, what do you want to do?
...Then, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Tch, truth is, I still don't want to give 
up...! I don't want to concede a single 
thing...!!
choice_data_list: ……なら、君はどうしたい？
……なら、貴方はどうしたい？

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be mortifying to end like this...!! 
I wanna be queen...!! I wanna be the star 
of the show...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
There's NO WAY I'm just gonna "forget 
it"!!!!!
choice_data_list: —I was waiting for that punchline!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ――――そのツッコミを待っていた！！！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: True feelings, you say...—
choice_data_list: ……よかった。本音でツッコんでくれて

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...! Could it be...?!
choice_data_list:
Sorry, that wasn't a very good joke, was 
it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ごめん、あまりいいボケではなかったね

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Then the truth is... you—
choice_data_list:
There's never been a moment I didn't 
believe in you.

There's never been a moment I didn't 
believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it as many times as needed, if 
this trust can give her even a little 
confidence as a queen.
choice_data_list: 俺が君に期待しなかったことはないよ
私が貴方に期待しなかったことはないよ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe in her. No matter the adversity 
or the rival, Lucky Lilac will endure and 
burst right through...!
choice_data_list: 君は耐えて咲き誇る花、最強の女王だ
貴方は耐えて咲き誇る花、最強の女王だよ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: だから、俺も『もうええわ』なわけない！
だから、私も『もうええわ』なわけない！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm, so sorry. I caused you trouble by 
saying something so foolish.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I... lied to myself. I was too scared to 
face Ai-san. ...Just to run away."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"B-But just now, when you told me I 
'didn't have to be the Queen'... I got so 
mad... I just couldn't hold it in—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"……I'll say it again. I wanna be the 
queen. I want to stand in the 
spotlight……!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to stop and say, 'This is 
where it ends.' Even if there is a limit, 
I want to stand up and face it...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why... could you please guide me 
even more strictly?
choice_data_list:
Got it. Let's aim for the top together 
again!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: わかった。また一緒に、高みを目指そう！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor as she smiled was so 
graceful, as if her identity as a queen 
were quietly being rekindled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's get it back from here. Let's make it 
even stronger. Her tsukkomi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that vow in mind, I will rise again 
with Lucky Lilac—
